notes.title: Post-Apocalypse Release To Be Delayed Further
notes.notes:
Greetings, preppers!

It hadn't been written in stone yet, but as tomorrow was the 6 year anniversary of Doomsday 2012, it was also the intended release date of the first episode of Afterdays. Due to unforeseen circumstances with Steamworks and frankly, the readiness of said episode, or in lieu of such, a Christmas prequel short, the release will be delayed further.

Another issue at hand here is the decision between releasing the game episodically versus releasing it all in one piece. Feedback would certainly be appreciated on that.

Finally, many 'thank you's must be said for those who've continued to stick around in this group and await this game being in your Steam client. It's always been an honour to be able to try to make this available here, but more than just that, to actually finish the game and its story. Regretfully, neither have happened. Hopefully, however, both will come in the near future.

Thank you once again for your patience ... and wishing you all a very Merry Christmas and a Happy New Year!
~ Afterdays Team
